svg.title: Upper left, a staircase of added units over a ruler whose slots halve: thirty units shared between two neighbouring entries, sixteen of them placed earlier, so the middle height is 16 and the count is 30 + 16 = 46; the last packet of two, red, was moved earlier and lifted that height by two, adding one step to the dyadic sum, while the height after the pair stays 30. Upper right, one row per split: sixteen windows of totals, each three steps wide and one step right of the last, so neighbours overlap and together cover one interval; window 8, red, is level with the middle height 16 and holds the target, a red dot on the axis. Below, that window enlarged 32/3 times holds the next group's 32 windows meeting end to end; the target falls in window 6, and two further enlargements by 32 show the same again, closing on the target.
